notes:
Inbound self-serve lead converted to discovery — SMB, customer-support SaaS. Signed up via hosted API free tier, started integration last week. Main complaint: end-users in EU and US see intermittent slow responses (~600-900ms to first token) during peak hours. Team suspect routing to single multi-tenant pool in us-east even though they are on us-west and eu nodes. They reported timeouts in client at 2s which causes UI flakiness. 

Client quote: "Sometimes chat freezes for a second then resumes; UX feels janky for demos." 

They run lightweight chat assistant + on-demand doc search. Typical prompts: user message ~40-120 tokens, retrieval + concat prompt ~300-800 tokens. Throughput low (20-80 reqs/min) but tight p50 latency target 200-350ms for interactive flows. Cost sensitivity: high (SMB). Prefer hosted API to avoid infra ops. 

SE notes from call: likely causes = region mis-selection, lack of streaming/early flush, client-side short timeout, not using token-based streaming or incremental rendering, no request-level region pinning. Recommend: enable region param on requests, switch to streaming with 500ms client-side fallback, lower response timeout to 8s server-side for retries, introduce prompt truncation strategy and retrieval chunking to keep prompt length <600 tokens when possible. Also suggested testing with model variant gpt-3-style-8k-quant (lower cost) and a faster model for guaranteed low-latency fallbacks. 

Security: SSO required later; initial POC ok with API keys. Audit log requirement for enterprise but they want to understand available logs on hosted tier. Data residency: prefer EU data for EU users; ask about per-region residency SLA. 

Requested artifacts: quick perf checklist, tuned prompt template, POC test harness (curl + Node example), pricing sheet for SMB hosted tier.

Actionable ask from AE: deliver region vs latency benchmark for their org (us-west, eu-west, us-east) and a one-page prompt tuning doc by 2026-03-10.

poC_plan: 3-step small POC: 1) Baseline latency measurement using existing integration (no streaming) in us-east/us-west/eu-west; 2) Enable streaming + region pinning + reduce prompt length (apply truncation rules) and measure p50/p95; 3) Test fallback policy: faster smaller model for 95% requests, full model for complex queries. Deliver results and recommended config in <7 days.
recommended_config: region=us-west or eu-west depending on user base; client timeout=3s for first-token streaming fallback, overall request timeout=8s; enable token-streaming and incremental UI render; keep retrieval prompt concatenation <=600 tokens where possible; enable prefix KV caching for repeated sessions; set batch_size low (1-4) for interactive flows; use cheaper quantized model for high-volume non-critical queries; route heavy rerank jobs to off-peak windows.
observation_summary: SMB wants self-serve hosted but perceives platform as variable latency. Issue appears config/edge routing and client timeouts rather than core model slowness. Low throughput but strict interactivity expectations. They need clear docs + quick wins (region param, streaming, prompt-length rules) to improve UX before procurement.
